name: io.github.omerfsen/nvidia-health-validation-mcp
title: NVIDIA Health Validation
description: Read-only NVIDIA health-validation: its check catalog and, if allowed, one GPU node's verdict.

runtimeArguments.name: --network
runtimeArguments.description: Share the host's network namespace, where serve listens on loopback. Use container:<serve container> when serve runs in a container without host networking.

environmentVariables.name: HV_MCP_SERVE_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Where health-validation serve listens: 127.0.0.1 or ::1. Default 127.0.0.1.

environmentVariables.name: HV_MCP_SERVE_UID
environmentVariables.description: If set, the numeric user ID that must own serve's listening socket. Linux only. Off when unset.

environmentVariables.name: HV_MCP_ALLOW_EVALUATE
environmentVariables.description: Exactly true adds hv_get_verdict, which runs a real evaluation on the node. Off when unset.

environmentVariables.name: HV_MCP_EVALUATE_INTERVAL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: At most one evaluation per this many seconds, 5 to 600. Default 10.

environmentVariables.name: HV_MCP_EVALUATE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for a verdict, 10 to 900. Default 150.
